lines: Cleopatra lived closer to the moon landing than the pyramids. Sit the fuck down.
The Great Pyramid was twenty-five hundred years old when Cleopatra was born.
Bananas are berries. Strawberries are fucking not.
A day on Venus is longer than its whole goddamn year.
Two hundred forty-three days of Monday. Hell.
You're about a centimeter taller in the morning.
Gravity squishes your spine all day, dumbass.
So who's closer to the moon landing? Comment, dumbass.
